questions.text: What are the main top-level modules or packages that represent the system's decomposition into user-facing functionality, application logic, domain entities, and data persistence?
What are the allowed-to-use relations and dependency directions among the core architectural layers (e.g., presentation, application, domain, persistence)?
Which module boundary crossings or prohibited uses exist between the domain entities and the data persistence infrastructure?
How are subsystem interfaces structured to support future evolution and replacement of external integration components without violating compatibility?
